mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past three months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past three months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.3 percentage points over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, prompting risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) over the past month signals a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in economic slowdown risks.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of instances where both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained expansion regime (characterized by high industrial production growth), strong INDPRO growth signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in sustained growth.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of periods within the supply-constrained expansion regime, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts (HOUST) level below 1150.0 thousand units signals a contraction in the housing sector, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to concerns about consumer spending and economic growth.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 0.2 percentage points over three months signals rising inflation, prompting expectations of monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous strong growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS > 100k) and rising unemployment rate (UNRATE > 0.2pp increase) signals a labor market with expanding job creation but increasing unemployment, which confuses the market about economic health, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS growth exceeds 100k and UNRATE rises by more than 0.2pp, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past three months signals robust supply chain activity and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market prices in strong economic fundamentals.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of periods where INDPRO has increased over the past three months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
